outcome: availability of emergency obstetric care (EmOC) services
intrapartum and very early neonatal death rate
cohort: Pregnant women receiving care at public health facilities in the Governorate of Sousse, Tunisia, in 2017.
finding: The study found limited availability of comprehensive emergency obstetric care (EmOC) services in the Governorate of Sousse, Tunisia, highlighting the need for improvements to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality.
